caption_draft: Model P(official open = UP) trajectories and direction accuracy by prediction time. Top: one line per day over 37 trading days (2026-05-19 to 2026-07-13), x-axis time of day (ET, 00:00 to 9:29), y-axis model P(up); green lines are days that officially opened up, red opened down, with dots at the right edge marking the official outcome. The two 9:29 misses are highlighted: 2026-07-10 (official +4.00 pts) and 2026-06-22 (official -0.14 pts). Bottom: direction accuracy (%) versus prediction time -- the hourly sample (n=134 days) rises from about 74% at midnight to 92% at 9:00, and the minute-level sample (n=18 days) reaches about 94% near 9:29, against a 96.3% ceiling attainable with perfect 9:30 market data (residual auction noise) and the 50% coin-flip floor.

caption_draft: Midnight prediction with coin-toss days removed. Days with midnight confidence below 65% (the shaded P(up) band around 0.5) are excluded: 88 of 200 days. On the remaining 112 confident days, 92 calls are correct (grey) and 20 wrong (red), lifting midnight accuracy from 72.5% to 82.1%. Axes as in the 200-day midnight figure: time of day (ET, 00:00 to 09:00) versus model P(official open = UP), dashed line at 00:00 marking prediction time, right-edge dots the official outcome. The exclusion filter is itself the trading rule: no bet on coin-toss days.

caption_draft: Stake economics for the first_signal rule (0.70 confidence gate): flat stakes swept from $25 to $2,000 with the calibrated execution model, bankroll unbound. Left: total PnL versus intended stake per trade -- test half (58 days, blue) reaches about $5.0k and all 115 days (green) about $13.2k at $2,000; the shaded region above roughly $400 marks where the impact model leaves its validated $100-500 calibration range. Middle: ROI per dollar staked -- flat at about 15.5% from $25 to $300, peaking near 19.6% (test) around $750, then declining. Right: effective stake actually placed versus intended -- fills bend away from the 1:1 line and asymptote to roughly $1,000, the liquidity ceiling of about 1% of a day's traded volume.

caption_draft: Bankroll trajectories for the $50-stake daily strategy on the test half (Apr 16 - Jul 14, 2026): hour-4 hold rule (enter at 04:00 ET when model edge >= 5c and traded-side confidence >= 0.60, hold to resolution), 21 trades, 19 wins - 2 losses, execution modeled with 1c half-spread and 0.1% impact per $100.
